[[The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Well, hello there! I could use your help right now. We're still barely acquainted, so I won't ask you to handle anything too serious just yet. I'm a solitary man, as you've probably already noticed. I try to live by my own principles and keep Tarkov clean. That takes time and effort, and sometimes my supplies run out. Usually when I least expect it. Could you find me some provisions? I don't need anything special, anything will do. The only requirement is that it's edible.}} ==Objectives== * Hand over any 10 items from the Food Category ==Rewards== * +3,000 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.1''' *80,000 Roubles ** 84,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|Thank you. Food in our time is a hard-to-get supply, it's hard to survive without it. Okay, we can talk about business then, when you have time. Come visit me from time to time, boy.}} ==Guide== The [[Provisions]] needed for this task don't require the [[found in raid]] tag. Food items can be commonly found in many maps such as [[Reserve]], [[Interchange]], and [[Shoreline]]. ===[[Reserve]]=== Food can be most easily found in the kitchen wing of the black bishop building. In the locked caged rooms in the underground bunker are many loose food item spawns and [[Ration supply crate]]s. These crates spawn a large amount of food. The number of supply crates in each room is written in red on the map below, as well as the location of the kitchen being circled.
